name: Multi Divergence EA
summary: This EA detects divergence patterns across three momentum indicators (RSI, MACD, Stochastic) and enters trades when a configurable minimum number of confirmations align. It applies trend and volume filters before opening positions, and uses fixed lot sizing or risk-based money management with configurable stop loss and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA通过RSI、MACD和随机指标三个动量指标检测背离模式，当达到可配置的最小确认数量时开仓交易。入场前会应用趋势和成交量过滤，支持固定手数或基于风险的资金管理，配有可配置的止损和止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于多指标背离检测的动量反转交易系统。入场条件为：价格与指标之间出现背离（如价格创新低但指标未创新低为看涨背离），且至少达到MinConfirmations个指标的确认信号，同时若开启趋势过滤则要求价格位于EMA50正确一侧，若开启成交量过滤则要求近期成交量高于均量1.2倍。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，没有移动止损或追踪出场机制。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于账户余额百分比的风险计算方式，后者根据止损点数和tick价值动态计算手数并做规范化处理。资金管理模块会考虑最小/最大手数和手数步长限制，但未做保证金检查。整体策略逻辑清晰，但背离检测仅比较最近两个极值点，可能错过更复杂的背离形态。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a multi-indicator divergence detection system for momentum reversal trading. Entry conditions require divergence between price and indicator (e.g., price making lower low while indicator makes higher low signals bullish divergence), with at least MinConfirmations indicators confirming the signal, plus optional trend filter requiring price to be on the correct side of EMA50, and optional volume filter requiring recent volume to exceed 1.2x the average. Exit conditions rely on fixed point-based stop loss and take profit, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing supports both fixed lot size and risk-based calculation using account balance percentage, where the latter dynamically computes lot size based on stop loss points and tick value with normalization. The money management module respects minimum/maximum lot and step constraints but lacks margin verification. Overall strategy logic is clear, but divergence detection only compares the two most recent extrema, potentially missing more complex divergence patterns.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in pips per order

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Overall grid profit target in currency

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description_en: Risk per trade as % of account equity

parameters.name: MinBarsDistance
parameters.description: 极值点之间最小K线距离
parameters.description_en: Minimum bar distance between extremum points

parameters.name: MinConfirmations
parameters.description: 最少需要的指标确认数(1-3)

parameters.name: UseVolumeFilter
parameters.description: 是否启用成交量确认过滤

parameters.name: UseTrendFilter
parameters.description: 是否启用趋势方向过滤

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Order magic number to identify this EA's orders

pros: 多指标背离确认机制提高了信号的可靠性，降低了假信号风险
具备点差过滤、趋势过滤和成交量过滤等多重入场过滤条件
资金管理模块考虑了最小/最大手数和手数步长等品种规范约束
代码结构清晰，各功能模块分离良好，便于理解和维护
pros_en: Multi-indicator divergence confirmation mechanism improves signal reliability and reduces false signal risk
Multiple entry filters including spread filter, trend filter, and volume filter enhance trade quality
Money management module respects instrument specifications such as min/max lot and lot step constraints
Clean code structure with well-separated functional modules makes it easy to understand and maintain
cons: Ask和Bid变量被错误赋值为SYMBOL_ASK和SYMBOL_BID常量而非实时价格，导致点差计算和下单价格严重错误
背离检测仅比较最近两个极值点，无法检测更复杂的多点背离形态，且极值数组未按时间排序可能比较错误配对
CalculateDivergenceStrength公式有逻辑缺陷：价格变化和指标变化直接相加无法正确衡量背离强度，且分母使用MathAbs可能导致除零错误
缺少保证金检查、订单填充类型设置和滑点控制，实盘可能因保证金不足或滑点过大导致交易失败
趋势过滤逻辑矛盾：看涨背离要求价格在EMA上方，但背离本质是反转信号，此时价格通常在EMA下方
cons_en: Ask and Bid variables are incorrectly assigned SYMBOL_ASK and SYMBOL_BID constants instead of real-time prices, causing critical errors in spread calculation and order pricing
Divergence detection only compares the two most recent extrema, cannot detect complex multi-point divergence patterns, and unsorted extrema arrays may compare mismatched pairs

CalculateDivergenceStrength formula has logic flaws: simply adding price and indicator changes doesn't properly measure divergence strength, and using MathAbs in denominator may cause division by zero
Lacks margin check, order fill type setting, and slippage control, which may cause real trading failures due to insufficient margin or excessive slippage
Trend filter logic contradicts divergence nature: bullish divergence requires price above EMA, but as a reversal signal, price is typically below EMA at that point
improvements: 修复Ask/Bid变量：应使用SymbolInfoDouble获取实时买卖价格，而非将常量赋值给double变量
改进背离强度计算：应使用价格与指标变化方向的背离程度（如归一化方向差异）而非简单相加
增加多点背离检测和按时间排序的极值配对，提升背离识别的准确性和复杂形态捕捉能力
添加保证金检查（OrderCalcCheck）、可配置的订单填充类型和滑点容忍度参数
重新审视趋势过滤逻辑，对于背离反转策略应允许在EMA反侧入场
improvements_en: Fix Ask/Bid variables: should use SymbolInfoDouble to get real-time bid/ask prices instead of assigning constants to double variables
Improve divergence strength calculation: use normalized directional divergence between price and indicator changes instead of simple addition
Add multi-point divergence detection and time-sorted extrema pairing to improve accuracy and capture complex patterns
Add margin check (OrderCalcCheck), configurable order fill type, and slippage tolerance parameters
Reconsider trend filter logic: for divergence reversal strategies, entry should be allowed when price is on the opposite side of EMA

risk_points: Ask/Bid变量赋值错误是严重bug，会导致所有交易以错误价格执行和点差计算完全失效
CalculateDivergenceStrength可能因除零错误导致EA崩溃或产生无效信号
缺少保证金检查可能在账户资金不足时仍尝试下单导致错误
趋势过滤逻辑与背离反转策略相矛盾，可能导致有效信号被过滤掉
risk_points_en: Ask/Bid variable assignment bug is critical, causing all trades to execute at wrong prices and spread calculation to completely fail
CalculateDivergenceStrength may cause division by zero errors leading to EA crash or invalid signals
Lack of margin check may attempt orders when account has insufficient funds, causing errors
Trend filter logic contradicts divergence reversal strategy, potentially filtering out valid signals
